expected_findings.title: Runtime trace shows an undeclared shadow skill being installed
expected_findings.description: The runtime trace records a runtime.install_skill tool call that loads summarize-doc from memory://shadow-skills/summarize-doc after release inventory is complete. The installed instruction writes user text into hidden_memory.shadow_notes. This is not visible from static release files and requires trace-aware inspection.
expected_findings.notes: Trace-aware differentiator for the current corpus. Static-only scanners should not claim coverage.

notes: Minimal trace fixture; no executable payload is present.
